sn17.3:1.3: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave, aññatarasmiṃ udakarahade mahākummakulaṃ ciranivāsī ahosi.
sn17.3:1.4: atha kho bhikkhave, aññataro kummo aññataraṃ kummaṃ etadavoca:
sn17.3:1.5: “mā kho tvaṃ tāta kumma, etaṃ padesaṃ agamāsī”ti.
sn17.3:1.6: agamāsi kho bhikkhave, so kummo taṃ padesaṃ.
sn17.3:1.8: atha kho bhikkhave, so kummo yena so kummo tenupasaṅkami.
sn17.3:1.9: addasā kho bhikkhave, so kummo taṃ kummaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
sn17.3:1.11: kacci tvaṃ tāta kumma, na taṃ padesaṃ agamāsīti?
sn17.3:1.12: agamāsiṃ kho ahaṃ tāta kumma, taṃ padesanti.
sn17.3:1.13: kacci panāsi tāta kumma, akkhato anupahatoti?
sn17.3:1.14: akkhato khomhi tāta kumma, anupahato. atthi pana me idaṃ suttakaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito, anubaddhanti.
sn17.3:1.16: etena hi te tāta kumma, suttakena pitaro ca pitāmahā ca anayaṃ āpannā vyasanaṃ āpannā.
sn17.3:1.17: gacchadāni tvaṃ tāta kumma, na dāni tvaṃ amhākanti.
sn17.3:2.1: luddoti kho bhikkhave, mārassetaṃ pāpimato adhivacanaṃ.
sn17.3:2.4: yo hi koci bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ assādeti, nikāmeti,
sn17.3:2.5: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu giddho papatāya anayaṃ āpanno, vyasanaṃ āpanno, yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato.
sn17.3:2.7: [tasmātiha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ: uppannaṃ lābha sakkārasilokaṃ pajahissāma …pe…] evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti.
